% Macros for the two advanced tables (generated by analysis/07_tables.py).
% Add these lines to the manuscript preamble, then \input the table files.
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{tikz}

% ---- in-cell horizontal data bar -------------------------------------------
% \dbar{fraction 0..1}{printed label}
\definecolor{barfill}{HTML}{C9DCEA}
\definecolor{barink}{HTML}{0072B5}
\newlength{\barunit}\setlength{\barunit}{11mm}
\newcommand{\dbar}[2]{%
  \rlap{\textcolor{barfill}{\rule[-0.22em]{\dimexpr#1\barunit\relax}{0.85em}}}%
  \hbox to \barunit{\hspace{0.4em}\footnotesize #2\hfil}}

% ---- delay-CDF sparkline (retained for the fallback layout) ----------------
\tikzset{sparkline/.style={line width=0.35pt,draw=barink,line join=round}}
\tikzset{sparkrule/.style={line width=0.2pt,draw=black!25}}

% ---- delay-spread glyph: quartile box, median tick, whisker to P90 ----------
\tikzset{glyphaxis/.style={line width=0.2pt,draw=black!22}}
\tikzset{glyphgrid/.style={line width=0.15pt,draw=black!12}}
\tikzset{whisker/.style={line width=0.3pt,draw=barink!60}}
\tikzset{medtick/.style={line width=0.75pt,draw=barink,line cap=round}}

% ---- improvement marker -----------------------------------------------------
\definecolor{gainink}{HTML}{0072B5}
\newcommand{\gain}{\textcolor{gainink}{$\blacktriangle$}}
